# OG Checker

> Checks how a web page's link preview will look when the URL is shared: it fetches the page as Twitterbot and facebookexternalhit, reads the Open Graph and Twitter tags, downloads and probes the og:video and og:image files (status, content type, range requests, MP4 faststart, codec, size, duration), and says which apps will play the video and which will show the og:image poster.

Base URL: https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app
No key, no sign-in. CORS is open. Rate limit: 20 checks per minute per client IP.

## Call it

- Markdown report (best for reading into a model):
  `curl -s "https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app/api/inspect?url=https://example.com/&format=md"`
- JSON (best for code):
  `curl -s "https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app/api/inspect?url=https://example.com/"`
- Human page with players and app previews:
  `https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app/?url=https://example.com/`

URL-encode the `url` parameter if it has its own query string. `/api/check` is an alias of `/api/inspect`. `Accept: text/markdown` also selects the Markdown report.

## JSON response, the fields that matter

- `summary.video_plays_in`: apps that will play og:video for this URL (today usually `["iMessage"]` or `[]`).
- `summary.everywhere_else`: `"poster"` (og:image shown) or `"none"` (text-only card).
- `summary.checks_failed`: labels of failed checks; empty means everything passed.
- `platforms[]`: `{platform, result: "plays"|"poster"|"none", note, source}` per app.
- `checks[]`: `{ok, group, key, label, detail}`; groups are `page`, `tags`, `video`, `platform`, `poster`. `platform` rows are facts (YES/NO), not errors.
- `card`: resolved title, description, image, video, og:type, twitter:card, domain.
- `video`: ffprobe facts (codec, profile, pix_fmt, width, height, fps, duration, audio, bytes).
- `poster`: format, width, height, bytes of og:image.
- `tags`: every og:* and twitter:* tag as `[name, content]`.

Errors are JSON `{"error": "..."}` with status 400 (bad or refused URL: private addresses, ports other than 80/443, non-http schemes), 429 (rate limit) or 502 (the target failed to answer).

## What the results mean (as of 24 Oct 2026)

- Only iMessage is confirmed to play og:video (autoplays muted and loops; poster with a play button when the recipient has autoplay off or Reduce Motion on; 10 MB cap).
- Discord plays it only when og:type is video.* or twitter:card is player. Do not tell a site to declare og:type video on a normal page just for Discord: it misdescribes the page to every other consumer.
- X (Twitter), Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Signal and Matrix show og:image. Facebook and Telegram were tested on devices; the viral "og:video works on X" posts were screen recordings of iMessage.
- So og:image is what most people see: it must exist, be 1.91:1 and at least 600 px wide, and match the video's first frame if there is a video.

## Advice an agent should give

- Video: H.264 (High or Main), yuv420p, MP4 with faststart (moov before mdat), served as video/mp4 over https with range requests (206), under 10 MB, ideally a short loop with no audio.
- Tags: og:video, og:video:secure_url, og:video:type=video/mp4, og:video:width, og:video:height, plus og:image (the poster) with og:image:width/height and og:image:alt, and twitter:card=summary_large_image.
- Version the video URL (for example `?v=<hash>`) when the file changes; previews are cached by URL.

## Specs

- Open Graph protocol (defines og:video and og:image and their structured properties): https://ogp.me/ (see https://ogp.me/#structured)
- Apple TN3156, rich previews in Messages (the og:video autoplay rules): https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technotes/tn3156-create-rich-previews-for-messages
- Discord link previews (og:video needs og:type video.* or twitter:card player): https://docs.discord.com/developers/link-previews/overview
- X has no current public cards documentation; its old Card Validator was retired.

## Other files

- OpenAPI spec: https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app/openapi.json
- Platform support data: https://ogchecker-bq3fs.sprites.app/support.json
